nodes.name: CareerDataTemplate.csv
nodes.summary: Seed data template listing software engineering career paths (Frontend, Backend, Full Stack, Data Science, etc.) with prerequisite career relationships and descriptions, used to bootstrap the career catalog.

nodes.name: RoadmapDataTemplate.csv
nodes.summary: Large seed data template defining learning roadmap nodes per career/skill, including stage, unlock keys, weight, completion policy, required proficiency, evidence keywords, node hierarchy, and reference links, used to populate the roadmap structure.

nodes.name: SkillDataTemplate.csv
nodes.summary: Seed data template mapping skills to categories, required careers, and importance level, used to populate the skill catalog referenced by roadmaps and career profiles.

nodes.name: flm_overlay.json
nodes.summary: Generated coverage overlay data (for the Backend career filter) reporting catalog skill coverage against university subjects, including a skill-to-subject coverage map, a gap list of missing skills with importance ratings, and summary counts.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured as a JSON report with summary counts, a skill_coverage map (skill -> subject codes), and a gap array (skills not covered by any subject), likely produced by an offline analysis script rather than hand-authored.
